title: feat(types,plugin-form)!: a record id is a string wherever metadata names one (objectui#9511)
body:
Fixes #9511

`Clause-②: yes`

Executes director batch **#195 item 1, letter A** (comment `5749154869`, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20T10:11Z), standing on batch #136 item 5 letter B. The ruling's operative clause, quoted:

> A record id is a **string** wherever metadata names one. The six declarations (`ObjectFormSchema.recordId`, `DetailViewSchema.resourceId`, `DetailSchema.resourceId` — TS declaration and zod mirror each) narrow to `string`, and so do `CommentEntry.recordId` and `MentionNotification.recordId` (the same principle; a knowing decision, as the seat asked for). `DataSource.findOne` then narrows to `string` and the five TypeScript-only plugin-form faces fall out of `ObjectForm`'s own schema.

and its acceptance pin:

> pin: `{ type: 'detail', resourceId: 42 }` is refused with the prescription, `'42'` parses, and all five `DataSource` id parameters read `string`.

---

## 维护者速读

**改了什么。** 记录 id 从今天起在**每一扇门**上都是字符串。第五扇也是最后一扇门 `DataSource.findOne` 收窄了,连带它背后三个**作者直接手写**的元数据键也收窄了 —— 表单的 `recordId`、详情的 `resourceId`(两个拼法、三处声明),每个都在**两张已发布的面**上同时动:TypeScript 声明,和手写的 zod 校验器。

**为什么必须动 zod 那一半。** 因为 **TypeScript 声明在解析时根本不运行**。作者写进 JSON 的数字,只有 zod 校验器拦得住。只改声明、不改镜像,结果是已发布面上的 `declared ≠ enforced`,而且 `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` **会一路绿着放它过去** —— 那个仪器只抓「镜像比声明更窄」,镜像更宽它不吭声。所以两张面一起动,这是本卡真正的技术核心。

**作者会看到什么。** 今天把记录 id 写成裸数字的元数据,升级后**校验不过**,而且报错会直接告诉你怎么改:加引号,`42` 写成 `'42'`。⛔ **平台不会替你转换**,这是故意的 —— 主键是数字的部署方在**自己的适配器边界**转一次,于是下游每个作者、每个调用方、每个适配器看到的都是同一种形状。这类部署方的线上字节其实早就是 `'42'` 了(`update` 在 objectui#9333、`delete`/`bulkUpdate`/`bulkDelete` 在 objectui#9712),本卡只是让最后那扇不一致的门跟上。

**代价在哪。** 另外四扇门当初在本仓**一个调用点都不用改**;成本全在 `findOne` 这一扇,因为它的读取方是作者面。这次连带动了五张表单面,外加两处编译器强制的残留(下面单独交代)。

**风险与回滚。** 风险集中在一件事:外部消费者如果手写了数字 id,升级即报错 —— 这正是裁决要的效果,报错带修法。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,没有数据迁移、没有生成物、没有 schema 基线要还原。

**你要做的。** 这是一次作者面收窄,`Clause-②` 已申报 `yes`,下面是完整的 accept-set 测量。⛔ 未获批准前本 PR 停在 draft,不翻 ready、不入队。

---

## Clause-② — the accept set moved, measured in both directions

Differential over **45 documents** across the three mirrors, parsed twice: once on this branch's freshly built `dist` (`--force`, no cache, from `813aaf75`) and once on a comparison worktree at the merge base `0c2eb5eee0`. Same script, same corpus, same instrument on both sides.

| reading | count |
| --- | --: |
| GREEN to RED | **9** |
| **RED to GREEN** | **0** |
| verdict unchanged | 36 |
| refusals carrying the prescribed repair | **9 / 9** |

The 9 that moved are the only 9 that could: the three keys times three numeric spellings (integer `42`, negative `-1`, float `4.5`). Every one refuses with `invalid_type` **at that key's own path**, and every message names both `'42'` and `objectui#9511`.

**Nothing that parsed red now parses green** — that is the `RED to GREEN` row, and it is a measurement over a corpus deliberately stocked with already-red documents, not an inference from the shape of the edit.

**Every zero carries a lit control on the same instrument and corpus:**

| control | role | reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title: 42` / `objectName: 42` | **lit** — keys that were already string-only | refused `invalid_type`, before and after |
| `type` set to a wrong literal | **lit** — the mirror still reads its own discriminator | refused `invalid_value`, before and after |
| object / array / boolean / `null` at the same key | **red-both, 21 rows** | refused before, refused after — nothing was loosened while the number arm was removed |
| key absent, `'42'`, `'rec_1'`, `''` | **green-both, 15 rows** | parsed before, parses after — the mirror has not started refusing everything |
| `zzqNoSuchKey` | **absent control** | green both sides (base is passthrough), so the corpus is not silently all-red |

⭐ Without the red-both and green-both halves the 9 refusals would prove nothing: a mirror that had simply broken would pass the subject rows too.

**All five `DataSource` id parameters read `string`** — `update`, `delete`, `bulkUpdate`, `bulkDelete`, `findOne` — asserted two ways in `data-source-id-surface-9511.test.ts`: compile-time `Expect` rows judged by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and a runtime census over the declaration text that reds even in a tree where `tsc` never runs.

## Reverse verification — both new pins are proven able to fail

Run through `ablation-replace`, which requires the anchor to hit and verifies the mutation on disk by blob hash before the command runs, then restores and proves the restore byte-identical.

| leg | mutation | on-disk evidence | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `crud.zod.ts` `resourceId` back to the union | anchor 1 to 0, blob `e70c30156759` to `90bb646a8847` | `authorable-record-id-string-9511.test.ts` **5 failed / 28 passed** |
| 2 | `data.ts` `findOne` back to `string or number` | anchor 1 to 0, blob `0f2a090279e1` to `3b5444834866` | `data-source-id-surface-9511.test.ts` **1 failed / 11 passed** |

Both restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. ⭐ Leg 1 is the sharper reading — only the `DetailSchema` rows went red while the other two mirrors stayed green, so the pin discriminates per mirror instead of failing wholesale. Leg 1 also proves these pins resolve the **source** and not a stale `dist`: no rebuild happened between mutation and red.

## The two paths outside the granted file surface — kept, and why

Both are compiler-forced fallout of the ruled narrowing, not scope creep. The full build does not compile without them, and each is the identical one-token edit as the five granted plugin-form faces.

**`packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`** — `BulkActionDialogProps.dataSource` hand-restates `findOne`. Without the edit:

```
src/ObjectGrid.tsx(5476,7): error TS2322: Types of property 'findOne' are incompatible.
  Type 'string | number' is not assignable to type 'string'.
```

⭐ This is the one shape in the tree where narrowing the protocol reaches a consumer at all. The interface declares `findOne` as a **method**, which TypeScript compares bivariantly — that is why the `DataSource` docblock has always warned that narrowing here does not reach implementors. This face declares it as a **property**, which is checked contravariantly under `strictFunctionTypes`. That file's own comment had already predicted the event, in terms: it says deriving those doors from `DataSource` means "any future drift of that face reddens HERE instead of passing silently". It did.

**`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`** — `buildFormSchema` asserted an untyped record bag's id as `string or number or undefined` and assigns it into the now-narrowed `ObjectFormSchema.recordId`. Without the edit: `src/ObjectView.tsx(1989,7): error TS2322`. `selectedRecord` is a `Record` of unknowns, so this was **always** a hand-written assertion; it now asserts the protocol instead of the wide shape. ⛔ Deliberately **not** `String(...)` — a reader-side coercion is the option the ruling refused by name, because eight such sites contradict 「the conversion lives in one typed place」.

⚠️ **How they were found matters, because the first survey missed them.** An earlier by-declaration survey of `findOne` call sites concluded every other site was already string-clean. That survey was incomplete by construction: the failing `plugin-form` task had stopped 5 of 29 build tasks from ever running. Re-run with `plugin-form` compiling, the build reached all **43** tasks and named these two. ⇒ the reading in this PR is **by compiler**, not by declaration, and 43 of 43 tasks now report.

## The ruling's `KnownDrift` note is an instruction over an EMPTY SET

The ruling's execution section asks for 「the `KnownDrift` / mirror-parity ledger rows shrunk in the same change」. **There are none to shrink.** Measured in `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: `resourceId` appears **0** times and `recordId` **1**, and that single hit is prose about an `onNavigate` signature, not a ledger row. Independently re-verified by the dispatching seat against `MirroredUndeclared` **50** as the control, so the zero is a real absence and not a dead query.

⇒ `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` is **untouched** — which is also why excluding it from this PR's file surface cost nothing. Stated here so the next reader does not go hunting for rows that never existed.

## Gates — hand-derived, since `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses for objectui

That script derives families from the objectstack tree it runs in and says so outright; this list comes from objectui's own root `package.json` scripts and `.github/workflows/`. Every exit code was captured to a file **before** any pipe.

| gate | exit |
| --- | --: |
| `turbo run build --filter=!@object-ui/site --force` (43 of 43 tasks) | **0** |
| `turbo run type-check` (81 of 81 tasks) | **0** |
| `vitest run` over the four affected packages — 504 files, 7685 passed, 1 skipped | **0** |
| `turbo run lint` over the four affected packages (0 errors; 875 pre-existing warnings) | **0** |
| the two new/extended pin files alone — 45 tests | **0** |
| `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) | **0** · **0** |
| `check-changeset-fixed` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-presence` | **0** · **0** · **0** |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:changeset-claims` | **0** · **0** |
| `check:spec-symbols` · `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only) | **0** · **0** |
| `check:doc-types` · `check:doc-snippets` (672 of 672 blocks judged) · `check:doc-examples` · `check:doc-fences` · `check:doc-example-ids` · `check:doc-example-readers` | all **0** |
| `check:prompt-keys` · `check:registry-bare-names` · `check:handler-key-reads` · `check:designer-field-key-parity` | all **0** |
| `check:test-path-roots` · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` · `check:vi-mock-inherit` · `check:vi-mock-override-shape` | all **0** |
| `check:readme-exports` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:self-import` · `check:sdui-registration-pins` · `check:element-data-source-declaration` | all **0** |
| `check:skills-paths` · `check:skill-examples` | **0** · **0** |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over 6 changed paths | **0** — NOT GOVERNED, none of the 5 governed surfaces matched |

**Honest notes on three of those readings, rather than letting them read stronger than they are.**

- `check:skill-examples` exits 0 over **0 selected fences** — no marked skill example carries these types, so that gate's corpus for this diff is empty. It is a real zero, ⛔ not coverage.
- `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:new-line-citations` are **report-only** by their own design; their 0 means "no findings", not "blocking and green".
- The test-and-lint pair ran inside one lock invocation joined with `;`, so the wrapper printed `batch-last-exit` and warned it does not cover both parts. That warning is correct and the wrapper's number is ⛔ not used here: each part's own exit code was written to its own file (`0` and `0`) and those are what the table reports.
- `turbo run type-check` was measured on tree `0492a2b5`. HEAD differs from that tree by **exactly one file** — `.changeset/9511-record-id-is-a-string.md` — and no tsconfig project in this repo includes `.changeset` (the one textual hit in `tsconfig.scripts.json` is inside a comment). The reading therefore transfers; said explicitly rather than presented as a run on HEAD.

## A note on this branch's history

The first commit on this branch, `0492a2b5`, is labelled INCOMPLETE AND UNREVIEWED and was **not authored by this seat** — the dispatching seat made it to stop the container reclaiming an idle worktree after this seat hit the usage wall mid-task. Every hunk in it has since been re-read line by line against the ruling and against the granted surface, and is adopted deliberately in `813aaf75`. Nothing in it was built on unreviewed. This repository squash-merges, so that WIP message does not reach `main`; this body is the record.

## In-flight overlap, declared

Two open pull requests touch files this one touches. Both unions are trivial and neither overlaps a line here:

- **objectui#9540** (`ObjectGallerySchema.filter`) touches `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` — different keys, different members. Whichever lands first, the other rebuilds in the queue.
- **objectui#8941** (lucide bump) touches `packages/plugin-grid/package.json`, `packages/plugin-form/package.json` and `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` — manifests and an unrelated member.

⚠️ Cross-card interaction accepted by the dispatching seat: **objectui#8345** derives a strict authoring twin from these mirrors, so its measured refusal figures move when this lands. The files are disjoint (it was re-scoped onto `strict-authoring-face.ts`) and the merge queue arbitrates.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` still declares `recordId` as `string or number`. ⛔ Left alone deliberately: it is not one of the five faces the ruling names, it does not hand that value to `findOne` (it goes through `String(...)` at its own read point), and it therefore does not break the build. It is the same *survivor* class as the three declarations on **objectui#10078** and belongs with them in one decision rather than being narrowed here on this seat's own initiative. **noted, not filed** — successor: whoever answers objectui#10078.
- `DataSourceMutationEvent.id`, `CommentSearchResult.recordId` and `RecordSubscription.recordId` are on **objectui#10078** and are ⛔ not touched here.
- No reader-side conversion was added anywhere in this diff. The count of `String(...)` coercions introduced is **zero**, which is the measurable form of the ruling's 「the conversion lives in one typed place」.
